content.text:
I merged #415 and released **v0.39.1**: https://github.com/cv/pit/releases/tag/v0.39.1

- **Merge:** I squash-merged #415 into `main` as `ec2a647`, and CI passed on that commit.
- **Release PR:** #416 updates `CHANGELOG.md` (a Fixed entry under `[0.39.1] - 2026-11-19` describing the recovery), the version in `package.json` and `package-lock.json`, and the README's pinned install example. Its 5 checks passed, and I rebase-merged it as `7b2f9ec`. CI also passed on that `main` commit.
- **Tag:** I pushed the annotated tag `v0.39.1` on `7b2f9ec`, and the Release workflow succeeded.
- **Published release:** `release.verifyPublished` found no problems. The release points at `7b2f9ec` and has no assets. A fresh clone of the tag installed its runtime dependencies (package version 0.39.1) and the sandbox ran, returning `2`.

Local `main` matches `origin/main` and the working tree is clean.

**Not done:** I didn't run the release guide's smoke test of the installed tag inside Pi, or a check on a real `openai-codex` model. The interactive check from the last run used the PR checkout and the test provider, not the installed tag. To pick up the fix, run `pi update git:github.com/cv/pit` and then `/reload`.
